_comment: Extra shots for just volleyball (build 26827091). No new keys: every shot is a combination of the game's OWN
actions (project.godot [input]), so your rebinds and controllers carry over. Applied on your next real touch.
RALLY  hold sprint + strafe and make the game's own touch:  set -> high_shot,  bump/spike -> low_shot.
topspin: hold forward (move forward: W / left stick up, any rebind) while touching IN THE AIR.
SERVE  hold sprint during the game's own serve hit:  tap (low charge) -> high_serve,  medium -> low_serve,
full charge -> fast_serve,  in the air (jump serve) -> jump_serve;
hold sprint + move back: on the ground -> standing_float, in the air -> float_serve.
BEND   hold move left / move right during another AIRBORNE mod shot (topspin, sprint+strafe): it bends left/right as seen from YOUR camera.
Ground touches keep the game's own curve.
CURVEBALL  hold the keys that walk you left OR right on an airborne rally touch. Its path starts at your cursor,
runs forwards (curveball.bar_forward m) and bends toward that side. EVEN BEND (default, curveball.even_bend):
the bend is the same all through the flight (constant curve) and the bar is the matching parabola
p(s) = cursor + forward*F*s + side*L*s^2; the ball lands at s = sqrt(hold), i.e. sideways = L * hold
(tap = the cursor, full hold = the max-curve end, L = curveball.max_lateral).
even_bend false = the exponential bend: p(s) = cursor + forward*F*s + side*L*(e^(k s)-1)/(e^k-1),
k = k_min + (k_max-k_min)*hold, lands on p(hold), curve in flight grows e^(k t/T) (saved for the end).
Indicator (spin shots only, Ball.curve != 0: Curveball, topspin-with-curve, any spin input).
Default spin_display=question: every client draws the same float uncertainty box from the
crosshair to the max landing, with a faint '?' near the true landing (FLOAT_MARK_* fade, small wobble).
spin_display=exact is the same shared box without the '?'. There is no hitter-only path.
curve_display_remote (grey|full|off, default grey): off hides the shared box on every client;
grey and full both use the same float-box colour so everyone sees the identical indicator.
Plain shots and float serves are left alone. Visual only. curveball.range_box: false = exact marker in exact mode.
FLOAT  hold back on an airborne rally touch (bump / spike / dump; an airborne set stays the game's back set):
the game's own float (Ball.solve_float + start_float, as its jump float serve) with its own float box.
One air intent per touch: forward > back > left/right (a diagonal picks the stronger of back / side).
Per shot: "combo": {"trigger":"touch|off", "hold":[actions], "context":"rally|serve",
"touch":"any|set|not_set", "air":"any|ground|air", "min_power":0, "max_power":1, "curve":true}
FREE PLAY / PRACTICE: every touch there is your own serve toss, so rally shots (Float, topspin, Curveball, sprint+strafe)
also fire on that serve contact when no sprint serve combo is held. In matches the serve contact stays a serve.
DEBUGGER  press F7 in game ("debugger".key) for the live custom shot debugger: keys/actions held, airborne/grounded,
serve contact window, which shot your touch would get now (or why it is blocked) and the last touches.
Off by default (start_visible); the same lines go to jv_mods.log as [jv-mods:shotdbg] while it is on.
Only where you are authoritative: Free Play, practice, offline, the menu, or when YOU host LAN/private/friends.
